gloss_en: Procreation/begetting (holadah) — the act of engendering and bringing forth offspring, i.e., conception and childbirth, extended in Rabbi Nachman's teachings to spiritual begetting (birthing souls, Torah novellae); the verbal noun of ה-ל-ד/י-ל-ד hif'il, not 'birth' as an event of being born (לידה) nor any other root
